data.title: Grande by Emaar
data.about:
Dubai’s Opera District is home to one of the most enviable residential destinations. This is Grande at Opera District by Emaar. Standing tall with 78-storeys, Grande is home to the most exquisitely crafted 1, 2, 3 bedroom apartments. Offering a lifestyle that cannot be paralleled, these homes have the mesmerising views of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline. Get the front-row seats to the beautiful dancing Dubai Fountains.

Grande has the ultimate high-street world-class lifestyle with promenades, luxury hotels, parks and more, amidst the most happening cultural hub of the city. The interiors of these homes have been created tastefully with beautiful aesthetics. The living area has large floor-to-ceiling windows to give you the best views of the iconic city.
